name: Caygri Checkout Fields for FluentCart
author: caygri

sections.description:
Caygri Checkout Fields for FluentCart is an independent extension that allows store owners to add extra checkout fields to websites using FluentCart.

Features include:

  • Add up to two extra checkout fields
  • Configure labels and placeholders
  • Required or optional fields
  • Save field values to order metadata
  • Display extra field data inside order details
  • Lightweight and easy to configure

Upgrade to PRO

Need advanced checkout functionality?

The PRO version includes:

  • Unlimited fields
  • Multiple field types
  • Conditional logic (AND / OR)
  • Drag & drop ordering
  • Dynamic show/hide fields

Learn more:
https://lab.caygri.com/item/fluentcart-extra-fields-pro/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/caygri-checkout-fields-for-fluentcart/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  3. Go to Checkout Fields in WordPress admin.
  4. Configure your fields.
